blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — On her 30th birthday, Jema Galanza dazzled with a game-high 15 points to put Creamline on the cusp of ruling the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. Galanza made sure there would be no birthday blues, delivering the goods in front of a Creamline-dominated crowd at Philsports Arena as the Cool Smashers swept first-time finalist Farm Fresh, 25-11, 25-16, 25-16, to take Game 1 of their best-of-three title series on Saturday.
